title: Why F1 Cars Lost Power at the Bahrain GP in Malaysia (Explained)
description:
Why did F1 cars lose power on the formation lap at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia? A mechanical engineer explains the 2026 power unit software bug at Sepang in plain English.

Wet-weather energy limits, low speed and low grip combined, and the software never gave electric power back. Hamilton had to reset his car from the cockpit.
